gen-tourney-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs its tall, rounded sans letters into a tight, compact line, with short ascenders and counters that stay open. Tourney's wide-stretched, uniform strokes sit above it, loud and athletic.
gen-tourney-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads modern and lofty, its lowercase standing tall. Tourney is best at shouting, with fixed-width strokes stretched wide and bulky, while Ubuntu is best at settling into sentences.
gen-tourney-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono feels precise and structured, with bowls left open on one side and loosely spaced glyphs that look magnified. And Tourney, cut in one stroke width and stretched wide, makes the monospace body look even more measured.
gen-tourney-gf-viga: Stretched wide with every stroke cut to one width, Tourney hits like a scoreboard. And Viga keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase, so give that sans-serif body a little extra size.
gen-tourney-gf-voces: Tourney's uniform stylus-like strokes stretch wide and bulky across the top. Voces follows with tall lowercase and strokes that vary only slightly, so a long page of sans-serif text would read smooth and unfussy.
gen-tourney-gf-winky-rough: Big, blocky, built for the scoreboard: Tourney has bowls that never thin at the sides. But Winky Rough keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so a long stretch of sans-serif text would feel dense and steady.
gen-tourney-gf-winky-sans: Athletic is the mood, with Tourney's smooth drawn-wire strokes running wide across each line. And Winky Sans, its capitals barely taller than lowercase, is the plain sans that keeps that energy from tipping over.
gen-tourney-gf-yantramanav: Tourney has bowls with no swelling, cut bold and wide. Yantramanav's tall lowercase and spacious curve openings give the pair its strongest quality: a loud heading over a tightly huddled, tidy sans.
gen-tourney-outfit: Outfit draws curves that finish well before they close, in a cable-like line with no swelling. Tourney's stretched, bulky letters stand taller in the lowercase above, so the heading hits first and the sans-serif text follows.
gen-tourney-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart. And Tourney's high, bulky lowercase sets a sharper, louder tone against its moderate height.
